legend: Gross appearance of the gland of a patient with four foci of familial papillary carcinoma, one oncocytic adenoma, and lymphocytic thyroiditis.
This papillary thyroid carcinoma includes oncocytic tall cells with a heavy lymphoid infiltrate (Warthin-like pattern).
Small papillary thyroid carcinoma. Both familial papillary thyroid carcinomas are not morphologically different from sporadic papillary thyroid carcinomas.

diagnosis: Thyroid tumour associated with the CHEK2 gene mutation
legend: This papillary thyroid carcinoma consists of large follicular cells with oncocytic cytoplasm and large irregular nuclei.

diagnosis: Familial papillary thyroid carcinoma associated with renal papillary neoplasia
legend: This familial papillary thyroid carcinoma, associated with chromosomal region 1q21 (fPTC/PRN), shows a papillary arrangement with a glomeruloid appearance.

diagnosis: Familial papillary thyroid carcinoma associated with renal papillary neoplasia
legend: This hereditary papillary thyroid carcinoma is morphologically similar to renal papillary carcinoma.

diagnosis: Familial papillary thyroid carcinoma associated with renal papillary neoplasia
legend: The positivity for thyroid transcription factor 1 (TTF1) confirms the thyroid nature of the papillary tumour.

title: Essential and supportive clinical criteria for non-syndromic familial follicular cell–derived thyroid tumours
tablehtml:
Essential:a

 

Follicular cell–derived thyroid carcinoma in ≥ 3 first-degree relatives

 

OR

 

Papillary thyroid carcinoma in ≥ 2 first-degree relatives

AND

Absence of previous radiation exposure and inherited cancer syndromes

Supportive:b

·   Patient aged < 33 years

·   Affected family member(s) aged < 45 years

·   Papillary thyroid carcinoma multifocal and/or bilateral

·   Papillary thyroid carcinoma in a male patient, particularly a young man

·   Background thyroid with a combination of benign lesions

aReferences for essential criteria: {11038215; 33025555; 17429563; 23734600; 32556933; 27561845; 11038215; 16613533; 33175120; 29239041}. bReferences for supportive criteria: {11038215; 18948764; 16030170; 33175120; 29239041}.
